label: Shoulder Seam Only
description: Decorative hand stitching limited to the shoulder seam places a single visible line of pad or pick stitching along the back of the shoulder where the sleeve head is set into the body, a location regarded as one of the most technically demanding in tailoring. This restrained placement signals hand craftsmanship without overwhelming the jacket's overall surface, and the slight unevenness of hand stitching at the shoulder gives the garment a living quality impossible to replicate by machine. It is a subtle, connoisseur's detail, more visible from behind and in motion than from the front.
